headline: TMG Holding reports 18.6% rise in nine-month net profit to EGP 15 billion
summary: Egypt's Talaat Moustafa Group Holding recorded an 18.6% increase in 9M net profit to EGP 15 billion, backed by a 24.1% rise in consolidated revenue to EGP 47.6 billion.
why: TMG Holding is Egypt's largest publicly listed real estate developer, operating major residential, commercial, and hospitality assets.

impacts.name: TMG Holding
impacts.why: Higher real estate sales and hotel revenues expanded 9-month net income.
